## Report

**Tool calls made:** 2 WebSearch, 1 WebFetch. No other tool calls.

### Search 1 — open-source automotive ECU with design docs and revision history
Exact URLs returned:
- https://github.com/KarlVaello/VehicleControlSystem
- https://openecu.com/category/blog/page
- https://nhivp.github.io/Awesome-Embedded
- https://www.scribd.com/document (link truncated in the result; not completed or altered)
- A ResearchGate publication link with no usable identifier in the result

**Candidate coverage:** Thin. Only KarlVaello/VehicleControlSystem is an actual open-source ECU-adjacent project with a stated wiki. OpenECU is commercial, Awesome-Embedded is a curated list, and the remainder are secondary sources (Scribd, ResearchGate). None of these came back as a formal engineering specification set with change notices.

### Search 2 — open-source EV BMS design files
Exact URLs returned:
- https://github.com/kanocarra
- https://github.com/Zbysekz/3S_BMS
- https://github.com/blob/develop/project-information (malformed — looks like a path fragment, not a valid repo; recorded as returned, not repaired)
- https://github.com/lblommesteyn/PulseBMS
- https://github.com/devicplan/bms
- https://github.com/AugustoS97
- https://github.com/SmartBMS/blob/master (fragment; no owner segment)
- https://docs.bms-ev.com/data
- Thread links with incomplete paths: https://www.diyelectriccar.com/threads, https://ecomodder.com/forum/showthread.php
- https://cear.ufpb.br/34_Final_Paper-PEDRO, https://www.semanticscholar.org/paper, plus several Scribd links

**Candidate coverage:** Better. Green-bms/SmartBMS was described as having a `01_Documentation/Drawings` structure, which best matches the blueprint's need for text plus diagrams and an existing engineering document to revise. devicplan/bms and Zbysekz/3S_BMS are secondary candidates.

### WebFetch — failure
Target URL: https://github.com/SmartBMS/blob/master
Result: **HTTP 404 Not Found**; no page body retrieved.

This is not an authentication or network failure. The URL was truncated in the search result (owner name missing), and the "blob/master" path points at a file rather than a directory, so GitHub returned 404. The real page content was therefore **not reached**, and the accessibility test is inconclusive. I did not attempt a repaired URL such as `github.com/<owner>/SmartBMS`, since that would mean inventing a link.

### Unresolved needs
- No confirmed-access project page yet. The verified `Green-bms/SmartBMS` repository root needs to be located via a further search or GitHub access before the blueprint's design documents and revision history can be read.
- The blueprint's core inputs — an existing engineering document, engineering change notices, and design specifications — were **not retrieved**. Only candidate locations were identified.
- Diagram/schematic coverage for visual verification remains an unretrieved hypothesis. The SmartBMS "Drawings" folder is the best lead, but its contents are unconfirmed.
- Several search results were truncated or malformed links; per instructions these were recorded as-is and not completed.
